metadata.timing_scope: Retrain time is the entire triggering Pipeline.partial_fit call, including validation, buffering, preprocessing, tree fit and publication. It is not isolated tree fit time. Instrumented flow includes CSV reading, predictions, training, assertions, counting and memory sampling; excludes model creation and result-file writing.
metadata.memory_scope: Logical reachable ndarray bytes of Pipeline, sampled before the stream and after updates. Excludes temporary allocations, Python overhead and benchmark logs/predictions. Not peak RAM.
metadata.evaluation: Predict before learning; warm-up excluded. Accuracy is correct-count / sample-count. Common interval continues online learning. No tail flush.
